text.text: Every engagement from scoping to retest, plus the findings and reports behind it. Start with the Dashboard each Monday. text.text: Every engagement follows the same stages. A client who knows the stages trusts the process and the price.
Stages

cells.text: Agree systems, dates, rules and fee
Assessors work inside the agreed window
Fixes checked after the client's remediation

text.text: Never skip
Written authorization from someone who can give it.
An emergency contact for the test window.
A stop word if something unexpected happens.
A finding that is not fixed was not written well enough. Write for the person who has to fix it and the person who pays for it.
Every finding answers four questions
What did we find, in a sentence a manager understands?
Why does it matter to this organization?
What should they do, in the order they should do it?
How will we know it is fixed?
Rating severity

cells.text: Someone could do serious harm soon with little effort
Serious harm is possible with moderate effort
Harm is possible but needs conditions to line up
Small effect or hard to use
Not a flaw, but worth knowing

text.text: Keep out of the row
Never paste passwords, personal data or exploit detail into a finding row. Point to the evidence store instead.
The report is the start of the client's work, not the end of ours. Retests are where the value is proved.
Within two weeks of delivery
Send the remediation plan with owners and dates.
Add the fix-by date to each finding row.
Schedule a check-in with the sponsor.
When the client says it is fixed
Press Needs retest.
Retest only what the finding described.
Press Mark fixed with the retest date, or reopen it with the new evidence.
